description: This file implements a Kubernetes resource printer that outputs resource and name pairs, supporting list handling and group/version kind extraction.

classes.name: NamePrinter
classes.description: A resource printer that outputs resource and name pairs, with options for short output and operation description.

methods.name: PrintObj
methods.description: Prints the resource and name of the given object, handling lists and errors.

methods.name: GetObjectGroupKind
methods.description: Retrieves the group and kind of a runtime object, with fallback for unstructured objects.

methods.name: printObj
methods.description: Formats and writes the resource name and operation to the writer.
